title: Definition of Ready (a story can enter a sprint when...)

checklist.item: The user story and description are understood; open questions are answered or noted in technical_notes.
Every story in dependencies.blocked_by is Done (or explicitly accepted as parallel work).
Story points agreed; anything above 8 is split first.
Tasks exist for stories of 5+ points.
The Rust concepts listed have been skimmed (Rust Book chapter or docs link) so the story isn't blocked on unknowns.
